arStrings.szText: This death cult is up to something out there. Best learn what.
This death cult calls themselves the "Úllo Sar." Not a name I've ever heard. Regardless, I should seek them out and see what danger they pose.
Search for the {icon:Marker_Rupture_S14_Season, 2.5} Úllo Sar in Helltides or in the open world
This death cult is spreading far more than depressing propaganda. I should return to Dannica of Zarbinzet and tell her about the Úllo Sar ritual. People must be warned.
